race.comment: KARREN (5) is a progressive mare who bumped into another smart one first up when just touched off at Geelong before justifying the short quote at Bendigo with a dominant win. She'll roll forward again and prove very hard to run down. CARRIEDO (6) ran a good race first up at Ballarat behind Aurora Belle who has since bolted in again. Fitter for that and sets up nicely to 1400m, looks a clear danger. ESCARPA (4) will get a fair way back but will be running on, it'll just depend on where she gets to in the run. BAJARIA (10) is going well. The win two back at Kilmore was dominant before a good run again last time, consider.
